meta.purpose: External experimental data for verification loop 5 of the SynGAS model
meta.rule: NO INVENTED NUMBERS. Every record must carry an opened source URL and a status. value=null means the source states the trend but does not tabulate the number.
meta.key_limitation: All retrieved kinetic data are at 1-10 bar and short contact time (kinetic regime); the model is a 20-31 bar EQUILIBRIUM + 10 K approach model. Direct comparison is a FALSIFICATION test, not a validation.

All retrieved conversion data are in the KINETIC regime at 1-10 bar; the model is an EQUILIBRIUM model. Loop 5 therefore compares model equilibrium conversion to measured kinetic conversion and is expected to show a systematic positive bias.
